title: Reject automatic non-Clifford Choi preparation from paired Bell-lift cancellation
statement: For Phi_U=(I tensor U)Phi_Q, unknown paired normalizer L tensor conjugate L yields (I tensor conjugate L U L^T)Phi_Q. With one logical qubit U=T and L=X, XTX=exp(i pi/4)Tdagger; normalized T and Tdagger Choi states have overlap magnitude1/sqrt2 and unhalved trace distance sqrt2. Ignoring the lift ambiguity therefore leaves a constant logical error.
